plain.li: Halfway there. Don't slow down now.
Half of "{AMBITION}" is done, and I'd guess the harder half is still ahead.
[winter] Halfway through "{AMBITION}", and halfway through winter. I'll take it.
[afterraid] We lost days to the raids and we're still halfway there.

warm.li: Look how far we've come. Thank you, all of you.

blunt.li: Halfway. Whoever's been slacking, I know who you are.

cheerful.li: We're halfway there! I've been marking off the days on the wall.

gloomy.li: Halfway. There's still plenty of time for it to fall apart.

cold.li: We're at half. At this pace it will be done on time.

plain.li: We're running out of time on "{AMBITION}". A few more days, that's all we've got.
I told everyone we'd do this. Please don't make a liar of me.
[night] Can't sleep. I keep thinking about "{AMBITION}" and how much is left.

warm.li: I know you're all tired. Keep at it, and we can say we did it together.

blunt.li: There's hardly any time left, and we're nowhere near done.

cheerful.li: We can still do it if we all skip lunch tomorrow!

gloomy.li: We're not going to make it. I should never have proposed it.

cold.li: At this rate, "{AMBITION}" will fail. Put more hands on it or let it go.
